# teams_tenant_network_subnet (Resource)

Manages the TenantNetworkSubnet policy via New-CsTenantNetworkSubnet / Get-CsTenantNetworkSubnet / Set-CsTenantNetworkSubnet / Remove-CsTenantNetworkSubnet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `mask_bits` (Number) Maps to the -MaskBits parameter.
- `network_site_id` (String) Maps to the -NetworkSiteID parameter.
- `subnet_id` (String) Maps to the -SubnetID parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
